title: How PlotForge Works
use_cases: Use when applying narrative structures like 3-Act or Save the Cat to a new manuscript
Implement when managing complex character relationships and worldbuilding details in one workspace
Configure when switching between manual writing and AI-assisted outlining
Use when performing targeted manuscript improvements via Scene Surgery
Implement when tracking plot consistency across multiple chapters
content:
From blank page to polished manuscript in three clear steps. Work manually, use AI assistance, or combine both; PlotForge adapts to your workflow.

1

Build your story structure manually with professional templates, or use AI to generate a complete outline. Apply proven structures like 3-Act, Hero's Journey, or Save the Cat, then customize every beat.

2

Write chapters yourself or use optional AI assistance. Organize with cross-references, track character relationships, build detailed worldbuilding, and visualize your timeline, all in one workspace.

3

Polish your manuscript with professional organization tools. Track consistency across characters, plot, and world. Use Scene Surgery for targeted AI improvements, or refine everything manually.

All three steps happen in one unified workspace

No scattered documentsAutomatic savingAccess anywhere

Hybrid workflow
